subject: Start shiny app in a separate session

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Start shiny app in a separate session
parts:
Hi

The very short question is, if it is possible to run a shiny app locally in a manner where the user is still able to use the R session that used to start up the app? I have set up a system that allows users to access the data present in the shiny app through a parallel R session, and it would be a nice touch if the user didn't have to manually start up a new R session to gain this ability...

best

Thomas
